expected: All MiniQMT operator commands enter MiniQMTExecutionRuntime as the only execution owner. CANCEL_ALL_OPEN_ORDERS cancels active child orders through gateway and terminalizes OMS state; FLATTEN_ALL_POSITIONS/FLATTEN_STRATEGY_SLOT generate sell-first execution through runtime/OMS with slot attribution and broker raw packets; RESET_STRATEGY_SLOT cancels/terminalizes slot orders and records settlement snapshot; REPLACE_ALPHA_SIGNAL_BOOK creates a new signal-book binding/target plan without changing execution code. Tests, validation history, and DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 evidence prove the behavior before BUG-210 closure.
